title: Ultrahuman globe and figures
description: A white section: a 48px two-line headline, grey copy, an outline pill and two big figures split by a hairline on the left, a large round globe on the right that fades into the page at the bottom. On phones the copy is centred and the globe, wider than the screen, rises from below and is cut by the section. Two dark glass score cards with mono labels float over the globe, fading in and then shrinking as the section scrolls past.
notes: the glass cards force the theme's dark colours with the dark class
CSS-only motion; the original's live-ticking counter is static here
